desc: Build adjacency list from edges; set up prefix distance array dist[node] from root via DFS/BFS.
Implement DFS carrying: current depth, window start boundary (deepest index excluded), and a dict mapping value -> last depth index on the current path.

At each node: update window start using last occurrence of nums[node]; candidate path length = dist[node] - dist[ancestor at window start], node count = depth - window start; update answer (maximize length, tie-break minimize nodes).
Record previous last-occurrence of nums[node], set it to current depth, recurse to children, then restore on backtrack.
Handle edge cases: single-node paths (length 0, 1 node) always valid; ensure answer initialized to [0,1].
Test against both examples plus random small trees verified by brute force.
